items.title: Sonny Rollins — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: I have talked to Coleman about that, you know.

ctx.x: Because I think I’m sort of a stream-of-consciousness type of a player. See, that’s why I call myself a “primitive.” I didn’t know what I was doing, but I was still doing something which had some value, but I didn’t know what I was doing. And that, and that’s, uh–Ornette Coleman did an interview recently with the guy, and the guy said, “Well, gee, Ornette, gee you never went to music school. You never learned to read music,” and all this stuff. And Ornette told him, “Well, gee, I’m glad I didn’t, because if I did…
